paragraphs: The XF P300 is the current performance-oriented petrol variant of the X260-generation XF, introduced as part of the Ingenium engine family. It uses the AJ200 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbocharged petrol engine, developed as part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular Ingenium architecture. The AJ200 is a different unit from the earlier Ford-sourced EcoBoost petrol engines used in the X250 generation, and from the Ingenium diesel units fitted to other X260 variants. The petrol Ingenium is widely regarded as a robust, generally reliable unit.

cards.body: A 2.0L I4 Petrol engine fitted to the XF P300 — X260 (2015–present).
